name: Asuka
source:
A Kunoichi hailing from an Eastern Kingdom with the moniker "Hikage".

She has a bright and cheerful personality unbecoming of typical Shinobi, but her skills as an adventurer are top-class.

She is a good friend and rival to her fellow compatriot Mizuho.
